description_en: Deletes a server from a specified anti-ransomware policy
description_zh: 接口调用成功后，会删除机器上的备份策略和客户端，如果删除机器对应的备份库中仅包含需要删除的机器备份数据，还会删除机器对应的备份库
name: DeleteBackupPolicyMachine

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server to which the anti-ransomware policy is applied.

You must specify at least one of the `UuidList` and `Uuid` parameters
parameters.help_zh:
防勒索备份策略防护的服务器的UUID。

`UuidList`和`UUID`不能同时为空
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the anti-ransomware policy.

You can call the [DescribeBackupPolicies](~~DescribeBackupPolicies~~) operation to query the IDs of anti-ransomware policies
parameters.help_zh:
防勒索备份策略的ID。
调用[DescribeBackupPolicies](~~DescribeBackupPolicies~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The version of the anti-ransomware policy. Valid values:

1.0.0
2.0.0

You can call the [DescribeBackupPolicies](~~DescribeBackupPolicies~~) operation to query the versions of anti-ransomware policies
parameters.help_zh:
策略的版本。取值：
1.0.0
2.0.0
调用[DescribeBackupPolicies](~~DescribeBackupPolicies~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_version

parameters.help_en:
The UUIDs of the servers to which the anti-ransomware policy is applied.

You must specify at least one of the `UuidList` and `Uuid` parameters
parameters.help_zh:
防勒索备份策略防护的服务器的UUID列表。

`UuidList`和`UUID`不能同时为空
parameters.name: uuid_list

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
